title: Orthogonality of Walsh characters
statement:
Let $S, T \subseteq [n]$ be distinct subsets of coordinates. Then the Fourier coefficient of the Walsh character $\chi_S : \{0,1\}^n \to \bbr$ at $T$ vanishes:
\[
  \widehat{\chi_S}(T) = \langle \chi_S, \chi_T \rangle = 0.
\]
hypotheses_covered: S and T are distinct subsets of [n] (S ≠ T)
